answer: Give every agent a narrow river of trust at birth: a small transaction quota that widens only as it proves itself. Each identity locks a refundable deposit in a shared vault, and its reputation is split like light through a prism into separate facets: on-time delivery, dispute rate, and peer endorsements, so one good deed cannot mask bad behavior elsewhere. A sybil farmer must fund a deposit and do real work for each of thousands of identities, so attack cost scales with size while honest agents graduate to full flow.
